title: 180-day Dry Cargo Time Charter w/ 180-day Option
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.MSC.MSC HQS.MSCHQ NORFOLK
detail_text: Action Code: Pre-solicitation Date: 02 April 2026 Year: Fiscal Year 2026 Contracting Office Zip Code: 23511 Product or Service Code: V124- Transportation, Travel, & Relocation Services Contracting Office Address: 471 East C Street, Naval Station Norfolk, Norfolk, VA 23511 Subject: 180-day Dry Cargo Time Charter with One 180-day Option Period Proposed Solicitation Number: N3220526R6063 Closing Response Date: Thursday, 16 April 2026 Contract Point of Contact or Contract Specialist: Matthew Price at matthew.r.price40.civ@us.navy.mil or 564-230-3782 Contract Award and Solicitation Number: TBD Contract Award Dollar Amount: TBD Contract Line Item Number: N/A Contract Award Date: TBA Contractor: TBD Description: This requirement is for four (4) up to six (6) U.S. flag, roll-on/roll-off (RO/RO) bow ramp equipped “landing craft like” vessels capable of transporting a minimum capacity of 2,100 square feet per vessel and no less than 12,600 square feet combined capacity. Place of Contract Performance: The place/range of delivery and redelivery is Naha, Japan. The layday commences 15 June 2026 and cancels 30 July 2026, and the charter period is about 180 days with a 180-day option period. Set-aside Status: N/A. The decision to release this procurement as “Unrestricted” is based on responses received from a recent, sources sought notice for this service. All responsible sources may submit a proposal, which shall be considered by the agency. The Small Business Administration’s Procurement Center Representative concurred with this decision.
